column3: “The LORD” names the subject expressed as he.
“great king” renders Jareb as a title; “wooden idols” replaces its counsel.
The BSB makes “the sons of iniquity” the ones overtaken and puts the question in the past; in the Hebrew war overtakes “them,” and the war is against the sons of injustice.
“yoke” supplies an object for passing over the neck.
The doubled wickedness is rendered as great wickedness.
